generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.
Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by any State Government / Government of India /Union Territory.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-) soon after contract has been issued to bidder.

As per Karnataka State Government order No.LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore Dated 01.01.2007 and Government Letter No.PW/134/BMS/2007 Dated 27.7.2007, a sum amounting to 1%of the bill amount will be deducted towards Construction Labour Welfare fund
The Item Rate quoted shall include the Royalty Charges on construction materials and other taxes as per prevailing Government Orders.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
Financial Year will be reckoned as the period between first day of April and Thirty first day of March of succeeding year (both days inclusive).
The Employer reserves the right to reject any or all Tenders without assigning any reason.
The Tenderer should maintain the scheme during the defective liability period
The Department is not responsible for any delay in accessing e-procurement portal.
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Period of completion mentioned in Bid document. should be attached)

Tenderer shall note that the Tenders of those found Eligible as mentioned in Clause 3 - Qualification of the Tenderer in Section 2: Instructions to Tenderers (ITT), will only be considered for evaluation.

The Tenderer shall scan & upload all the original documents required for this bid to the e- procurement portal. The Original Documents should be produced at the time of opening of Bid for physical verification.
It is to be noted that any false documentation is found to be uploaded, the action may attract punitive measures such as blacklisting, cancellation of registration etc.,
The contractor should follow terms and conditions as specified in standard bid document KW- 1/2/3/4 whichever is applicable.
Work will be carryout as per the TOR enclosed

The contractor should submit water quality reports for every 15 days at WTP & OHTs, log book, for usage of consumables registers are to be maintained & duly signed by AEE same will be submitted and GPS photos are submitted with the bill otherwise bills will not be accepted.
After opening of Technical bid, eligible bidders work done will be sent to work done verification to concerned authority, more than 5 days for conformation delay of work done will be rejected.
Corrigendums / modifications / correction, if any, will be published in the website only.
Any working staff in this O&M work should be paid minimum labour wages as per act as directed under Govt.
Acceptance / Cancellation of the works are reserved by under signed without any reasons for the same.

All the scanned documents pertaining to bidder to be uploaded shall be in original and same originals should be produced to the Executive Engineer (at the time of Technical Bid Opening) who reserves right to verify the original documents before approval.
To qualify for award of this contract, each Tenderer should give all details and documents as per Technical and Financial bid attached to this tender.
If any date in the tender time table is government holiday, next working date will be considered.
Tenderer must submit his present accurate postal address and phone / cell phone number.

The rates of items are inclusive of cost of materials, labour charges, HOM of machinery, all lead and lifts and all other charges to complete the work successfully as per specifications and as directed by engineer in charge of work.
Any objection regarding the tender must be submitted directly to Executive Engineer, not in inward.
For interpretations of clauses, conditions, spelling mistakes, etc., decision of Executive Engineer, RDW&S, Raichur is final.
Vehicle requirements & Staff requirements should be according to the Sanctioned Estimate.

Within 20 days of receipt of the Letter of Acceptance, the successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given below for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract.
The employer reserves the right to accept any tender and to reject any or all tenders without assigning any reason.
GST shall be paid separately at the time of payment as per the prevailing rates

The salaries of the staff should be paid by RTGS/NEFT within 5th of every month to the respective bank account and same should be submitted along with the quarterly bill along with the document showing that the EPF and ESI amounts have been credited to the personal EPF/ESI accounts of the said staff. Any delay in payment of salary of staff will attend penalty of 1% amount put to tender of this work.
The contractor liable to carry out any leakages from source to WTP & from WTP to OHTs and also check periodically leakages in pipeline.
The contractor shall install SIM based Bulk meter before commencing of O&M work. Payment for supplying portable water to the habitations are based on the SIM based bulk flow meter readings.
All other Conditions mentioned in Bid document.

itemList.description: PART- A OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE:-Operation and maintenance of the scheme, which includes, providing technical staff, valveman, operators, and others who are required to run the system in complete manner and providing all  materials & chemcials required, for operation of jack wells / WTP and other allied components for supporting purification of raw water of the scheme to required level of functioning which is inclusive of transportation of materials to required spot (and etc. Excluding cost of Electricity charges) with all lead & lift charges including earth work excavation for  pipeline repairs if found necessary.1. Regular  maintenance of  civil structures like Jackwells /  Floating plat form, WTP, PWS, Master balancing tank, pump house and all other civil structures. The  maintenance consists of all kinds of repairs to damaged structures, cleaning and washing, over hauling and greasing of all machineries as and when required in a complete manner as directed by the Engineer in charge of the work.  The civil structures should be painted once in two years is compulsory. 2. Repairs and replacement of damaged pipe line,  valves etc.if found necessary.  It includes cost of  materials and labour charges and also monitoring of the systems.  The maintenance involves raw water rising main, gravity mains, pure water rising mains, and auxiliary pipelines assuring required discharge in pipes including controlling all the valves so that each village will get required quantum of water as planned in original scheme report. 3. Operation and maintenance of  water treatment plant including dosing of required quantity of alum ,chlorine and other chemicals including replacement of sand / filter media as required as per standard established norms from time to time.   Maintaining the quality of water as per the guidelines of CPHEEO mannual and BIS specifications including cost of testing of water at laboratory at regular interval in a complete manner as directed by the engineer in charge.  4. Operation and maintenance of all kinds of pumping machinery, other mechanical components of this scheme including electrical maintenance covering all repairs / replacement of transformers / Electrical cable / switch board / replacement of burnt parts for pumping machinery including rewinding and replacing of all types of parts to the V.T. Pumps, Submersible Pumps, Centrifugal Pumps / earthing etc. if found necessary, complete, including regular cleaning greasing and oiling of all components of machinery. Attending all the repairs / replacement of all damaged parts of machineries as directed by the Engineer in charge with all lead and lifts, etc.  complete.  All the activities during the operation and maintenance of the scheme should be carried out in complete manner as per the directions of Engineer in charge. All the above repairs & maintenace will be  carried out as per the direction of the Engineer-in-charge for satisfactory functioning of the scheme to provide designed LPCD of drinking water to all the habitatants of the Project villages. Note: Helpers / Watchman / Valve man / Technical staff made available round the clock for maintenance period at Jackwell, WTP and Pure water Sump points. 1. The G.P. or VWSC / concerned Section Officer of the Project  should certify the satisfactory functioning of the scheme and based on this payments will be made to the contractor 2. The contactor should maintain a Log Book on the working of  pumping machinery at Jackwell, WTP etc. I)   1st year Maintenance
